title: WITH (CTEs) — Temporary Named Queries
description:
## WITH (CTEs)
`WITH` creates a temporary named query that exists only for a single statement. It makes complex queries more readable by breaking them into named steps.

Example:
```sql
WITH active_tickets AS (
    SELECT * FROM tickets WHERE assigned_to IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT * FROM active_tickets;
```
The CTE `active_tickets` only exists for that one query. Think of it as a named subquery.
